'''Ord Yndar'''<ref name="EGTW" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="CSWE Ord">{{CSWECite|II|419|Ord}} states that the term "[[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]" and the abbreviation "Ord" applied to certain [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].</ref> located in the [[Ord Yndar system/Legends|Ord Yndar system]], a part of the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ord Yndar served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], despite it being located just outside the borders of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Specifically, the world served as the launching point for Republic attacks toward [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] during the [[First Pius Dea Crusade]] of [[11,965 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Yndar was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Ord Yndar [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Ord Yndar, in grid square Q-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
